deviations.change: Package-budget criterion is the frozen 0.2.9 transition plus the recorded supersession map, not the era's absolute counts (the former publishable 17 / provider 19 / 55 + added + delta branch)
deviations.rationale: Plan 054 consolidated 62 manifests into 10 and plans 055/062 added three provider subpaths, so the era's absolute counts can never hold again; the branch that guessed them by counting live capability packages failed on every consolidation. Frozen arithmetic stays (51 + 4 = 55, 50 + 4 = 54, 14 + 3 = 17, 9 + 1 = 10, 0 new runtime dependency names) and the live graph is checked through the map, so an unrecorded package or provider addition fails instead of being papered over (plan 071 Task 11)

packageBudget.$comment: Frozen 0.2.9 transition. The four new manifests over 0.2.8 are prism-impeccable, provider-clinepass, provider-deepseek and provider-xai (`git diff --name-only v0.2.8 v0.2.9 -- 'packages/*/package.json'`); 14 -> 17 counts the three provider adapters and 9 -> 10 the office family. These numbers are never re-derived from the live tree (plan 054 consolidated 62 manifests into 10): the live graph is checked through `supersession` + `lateAdditions`, and an unrecorded package or provider addition fails (plan 071 Task 11). Full 55-name era map: docs/_evidence/phase54-package-map.md section 3.
